paite: Ka hinna aw, TOUPA phat inla; ka sung a om tengteng aw, amin siangthou phat in!
heading: Pathian Itna David Phatna La
english: By David. Praise Yahweh, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name!

paite: Ka hinna aw, TOUPA phat inla, athil hihhoih tengteng mangngilh ke'n.
english: Praise Yahweh, my soul, and don’t forget all his benefits,

paite: Ama'n na thulimlouhna tengteng angaidam a; na natna tengteng ahihdam hi.
english: who forgives all your sins, who heals all your diseases,

paite: Manthatna lak a kipan na hinna atan a; zahngaihna leh lainatnate ahon khusak hi.
english: who redeems your life from destruction, who crowns you with loving kindness and tender mercies,

paite: Na kam thil hoih in ataisak a; huchi in na valnouna muvanlai bang in siam thak in a-om nawn hi.
english: who satisfies your desire with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.

paite: TOUPA'N, nuaisiahna thuak tengteng a ding in thil kizente hihsak in, vai ahawmsak nak hi.
english: Yahweh executes righteous acts, and justice for all who are oppressed.

paite: Alampite Mosi atheisak a, athilhihte Israel suante leng atheisak hi.
english: He made known his ways to Moses, his deeds to the children of Israel.

paite: TOUPA lainatna a dim, mihehpih theitak, lungneltak, zahngaihna hautak ahi.
english: Yahweh is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness.

paite: Ama'n atai kei ding a; ahehna apai nilouh sam kei ding hi.
english: He will not always accuse; neither will he stay angry forever.

paite: I khelhnate bang in i tung uah ahih kei a, i thulimlouhnate bang in ahon thuk sam kei hi.
english: He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor repaid us for our iniquities.

paite: Van, leitung sangtak a a-om bang in, amah laute tung ah azahngaihna alian mahmah ahi.
english: For as the heavens are high above the earth, so great is his loving kindness toward those who fear him.

paite: Suahlam leh tumlam a kigamlat bang in, i tatleknate tuh eimah a kipan in akoihmangta hi.
english: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.

paite: Pa'n atate ahehpih bang in, TOUPA'N amah laute ahehpih hi.
english: Like a father has compassion on his children, so Yahweh has compassion on those who fear him.

paite: I pumpi kibawlkhiakdan athei a; leivui lel i hi chih atheih ziak in.
english: For he knows how we are made. He remembers that we are dust.

paite: Mihing damsung nite loupa bang ahi a; loubuk a pak bang in alun hi.
english: As for man, his days are like grass. As a flower of the field, so he flourishes.

paite: Huih in amut a, amang hi; a-omna mun in athei nawnta kei ding hi.
english: For the wind passes over it, and it is gone. Its place remembers it no more.

paite: TOUPA zahngaihna bel amah kihtate tung ah tangtawn a pan tangtawn pha in a-om ding a, adiktatna leng ata suan atu suan tan un a-om ding hi.
english: But Yahweh’s loving kindness is from everlasting to everlasting with those who fear him, his righteousness to children’s children,

paite: Athukhun zui peuhmahte leh, athuhilhte man tum a theigige peuhmahte tung ah.
english: to those who keep his covenant, to those who remember to obey his precepts.

paite: TOUPA'N alaltutphah van ah ahihkip a; agam in bangkim tung ah vai ahawm hi.
english: Yahweh has established his throne in the heavens. His kingdom rules over all.

paite: Athu ngaikhia a, athu mang nou a-angelte aw, hatna a thupite aw, TOUPA phat un.
english: Praise Yahweh, you angels of his, who are mighty in strength, who fulfill his word, obeying the voice of his word.

paite: Asepaihte aw, adeihlam hih a nasemte aw, TOUPA phat un.
english: Praise Yahweh, all you armies of his, you servants of his, who do his pleasure.

paite: Avaihawmna mun peuhmah a athilhih tengteng aw, TOUPA phat un; ka hinna aw, TOUPA phat in.
english: Praise Yahweh, all you works of his, in all places of his dominion. Praise Yahweh, my soul!
